claim: The AWS Managed Rules groups for Bot Control, Fraud Control account takeover prevention (ATP) and account creation fraud prevention (ACFP) are available for additional fees beyond the basic AWS WAF charges, and you are also charged additional fees when you use the Anti-DDoS managed rule group (AWSManagedRulesAntiDDoSRuleSet).

evidence.quote: *The AWS Managed Rules rule groups for AWS WAF Bot Control, AWS WAF Fraud Control account takeover prevention (ATP), and AWS WAF Fraud Control account creation fraud prevention (ACFP)* are available for additional fees, beyond the basic AWS WAF charges.
The advanced tier of DDoS protections is offered through the `AWSManagedRulesAntiDDoSRuleSet`.
You are charged additional fees when you use this managed rule group.

note: d027, d030. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: 'All other AWS Managed Rules rule groups are available at no additional cost' was dropped from the claim, because the Anti-DDoS managed rule group (2025-06-11) also has fees and that list does not name it.
